verdict.rationale: Cloudflare MoQ relays can be created and managed through a first-party API, not only the dashboard, including issuing scoped tokens with expiration times. An OpenAPI spec is published, so relay provisioning can be scripted headlessly. Nothing documents a CLI, CI integration, or an automation-specific workflow, so only the API-driven core of the story is evidenced. missing for 10: CLI or Terraform-style tooling, CI/automation guides or examples, hands-on corroboration of headless use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Cloudflare MoQ relays are available through the [Cloudflare dashboard ↗︎](https://dash.cloudflare.com/) and the [API](/api/resources/moq).
You can create additional tokens and set expiration times using the [API](/api/resources/moq).
Cloudflare returns a relay ID and two default tokens: one that can publish and subscribe, and one that can only subscribe.
